description: Browser extension copy. where it goes: nothing leaves this browser except to the solstone app on this computer....
context: the solstone extension, speaking to the owner, on the agreement. the body is one template with three replacements, and the renderer depends on '- '. split. this select is only the where-paragraph. pause sentence, computer: pausing the solstone app stops this extension too, unless you turn that off in settings. mobile: pausing Safari in the solstone app stops this extension too. private sentence, computer: the solstone extension takes in nothing from private windows, even where your browser lets it run there. mobile: the solstone extension takes in nothing from private browsing, even where Safari lets it run there. each bullet becomes its own message starting 'it takes in', so the list does not depend on '- '. do not change what is taken in. CLO owns whether this agreement may be restructured.
